Business problems

  • Facility space, pick and place points, payloads, and safety zones lack consistent definitions.
  • Changing the robot or gripper affects reachability, motion paths, and estimated cycle times.
  • Equipment delivery, installation acceptance, and software estimates need different checks and records.

Engineering capabilities

  • Turn verbal requirements, CAD, equipment specifications, and spatial constraints into reusable inputs.
  • Check reachability and layout constraints with engineering rules and keep the assumptions behind each cycle-time estimate.
  • Produce 2D and 3D layouts, a bill of materials, and risks that need on-site validation.

Frequently asked questions

Can you guarantee an on-site cycle time?

Estimates record motion, gripper, and operating assumptions. Final cycle times depend on acceptance testing with actual equipment and workpieces.

Do you need the production CAD drawings for the first call?

Start with anonymized dimensions, workpiece ranges, and representative operations, then agree on drawing formats and confidentiality.
